summary.one_liner: A Pi coding-agent extension that fuses 2–5 frontier models (one architect, one primary builder, up to three secondary builders) into N-way opinions, debate, fusion, coordinated implementation, and gate-first validation rather than picking a single model.
summary.what_it_does: It is a composable extension for the Pi coding agent that runs 2–5 configured models against the same problem instead of choosing one. Commands include /fh-opinion (every model answers read-only), /fh-debate (multi-round read-only debate where agents see each other's labeled opinions), /fh-fusion (read-only research followed by one temporary writer agent that produces a fused result, which is then synced to every slot with ACK checks), and /fh-collaborate (models plan independently, the architect merges plans into a dependency DAG, and tasks execute with one shared-CWD writer at a time). /fh-only routes a single prompt to one slot, and /fh-model switches models per slot for the session. /fh-auto-validate writes a uv acceptance gate before building and has the builder iterate until the gate passes. Model stacks are defined in explicit YAML files with per-slot thinking levels, colors, and system prompt overrides. The README describes a single-writer invariant and a model bar widget showing speed, cost, and context per slot.
use_cases: compare answers from several frontier models on the same coding question
run a multi-round debate between models to reach a decision
have one model write code while others review and research read-only
split a feature into parallel tasks across different models
gate-first test-driven building with an acceptance check
route a single prompt to a chosen model in an agent session
notable: Single-writer invariant: read-only tool allowlists for opinion and debate, and a CWD-scoped atomic writer lease so only one agent modifies the checkout
Fusion context sync: the fused result is delivered to every model and each must reply with an exact SHA-256-tracked ACK
Dependency-driven collaboration DAG where independent tasks run in parallel and write tasks are serialized
Explicit YAML model stacks with validation rules, plus pre-built recipes such as just fusion and just fusion5
caveats: Requires several paid provider API keys (Anthropic, Gemini, Fireworks, OpenAI, OpenRouter) and the Pi coding agent installed globally
Stacks are validated at startup; invalid or unavailable model configs fail launch
Session transcripts for secondary slots are discarded when pi quits; only the Main host keeps context across restarts is not stated, so transcripts are not resumed
Multi-model runs are costly and slower than single-model use, and the README does not give cost estimates
